scenarios.capability: Create/edit/connect/disconnect, Save versus Save and Connect, TLS/CA and policy controls

procedure.action: Create a PostgreSQL profile; choose a synthetic CA file and set explicit policy. Save, edit, Save and Connect, disconnect, then delete. Repeat for MySQL.

scenarios.capability: Stable profile/document IDs, selected profile/document and tab order

procedure.action: Create two profiles and three SQL tabs. Reorder tabs, select the middle tab/profile, restart, then remove the first profile.
assertions: selection follows stable identity rather than vector position.

scenarios.capability: Explicit new-profile default, legacy defaults and environment/readonly fidelity

procedure.action: Create a new profile without touching policy. Reload an existing development/readonly profile; import each explicit environment/readonly pair and a legacy record.
assertions: New product profile is unspecified/readOnly=false and verify-full TLS.

scenarios.capability: Credential-safe profile update/delete with rollback, empty/missing distinction and locked-store errors

procedure.action: Save a profile with a synthetic password, update it with keep/empty/replacement states, inject metadata failure, then inject credential delete and rollback failures.
assertions: metadata failure restores the prior credential.
no password is written to JSON or diagnostics.

scenarios.capability: Private versioned library, exact backups, migrations, corrupt/future-version preservation

procedure.action: Load legacy, corrupt and future-version library fixtures; attempt edits after failed load; inject an atomic-replace failure.
assertions: Legacy exact-byte backup and IDs survive.
failed saves preserve the prior library and selected identity.

scenarios.capability: Strict portable v2 export/v1 import, preview/select, new IDs, no secrets, disconnected result

procedure.action: Export both synthetic engine profiles. Inspect JSON, import v2 and v1, preview/select one and all, cancel once, then complete import. Try secret/unknown/duplicate keys and excessive depth/count/size.
assertions: accepted imports have fresh IDs and stay disconnected.

scenarios.capability: Portable CA hint/remapping without weakening TLS; native CA file choice

procedure.action: Export a profile referencing a local CA; import on the other OS with the file missing. Remap using its native chooser, then roundtrip back to Mac. Cancel the remap once.
assertions: POSIX/Windows path hints do not become invalid trusted paths.

scenarios.capability: Explicit bounded --connect-stdin launch, ordinary launch reads nothing, no SQL execution

procedure.action: Launch ordinarily with an unreadable/blocking stdin. Launch --connect-stdin with one synthetic payload; test 64 KiB overflow, five-second timeout and retry after failure.
assertions: explicit launch connects once and executes no SQL.

scenarios.capability: Independent physical SQL sessions, transaction/SET/temp state, simultaneous profiles and isolated disconnect

procedure.action: Connect two SQL tabs on each engine. BEGIN/create temporary state/SET in A; query temporary state and transaction status in B; run both concurrently and disconnect only B.
assertions: Physical sessions and state stay independent.
the active tab/profile cannot redirect a completion.
A and catalog remain connected after B closes.

scenarios.capability: Catalog/completion service session isolated from SQL-tab and Apply sessions

procedure.action: BEGIN in SQL tab A, then browse catalog and request completion metadata. Stage and Apply a synthetic table edit. Inspect helper sessions.
assertions: Apply uses a fresh idle session.
A remains uncommitted with its original SET/temp state.

scenarios.capability: Stop/timeout/progress/row status, terminal response and responsive bounded streaming

procedure.action: Execute a query larger than row/byte/result-set display bounds, hold chunk ACKs, request Stop under backpressure, and kill the owned helper in a second run.
assertions: control messages and terminal delivery remain responsive.
partial completed results and authoritative transaction state survive.

scenarios.capability: Close scopes, open/failed transaction choices, repeated Quit and disconnect acknowledgement

procedure.action: Close a tab, profile, window and application with idle, open and failed transactions. Cancel, Roll Back and Commit independently; repeat Quit during commit/disconnect.
assertions: repeated Quit keeps the same decision.
process exits only after acknowledged disconnect.

scenarios.capability: Stop and Continue, Apply/Discard/Cancel, inline draft/export/unknown close states

procedure.action: Close while a query runs, while inline edit/draft exists, during export and after unknown Apply. Choose Stop and Continue, Apply/Discard/Cancel as available.
assertions: each close scope resolves all affected work.

scenarios.capability: Independent tab text/caret/selection/scroll/Undo, SQL line numbers/current line and exact plain-text input during app lifetime

procedure.action: Paste Unicode/CRLF and literal straight quotes/dashes into two SQL tabs. Set different caret/selection/scroll, edit and Undo in both; switch tabs and themes.
assertions: each tab retains independent editing and Undo state.

scenarios.capability: One source resolver for selection/current statement/script, highlights, commands and export

procedure.action: For each SQL corpus case, run a selection, caret statement (including just after semicolon), and entire script; invoke from toolbar/menu/keyboard and Run to File.
assertions: One resolver chooses the same original range for all entry points.
highlights and summary identify exact source.

scenarios.capability: PostgreSQL/MySQL splitter, routine bodies, delimiters, diagnostics and client-command rejection

procedure.action: Execute parser corpus including PostgreSQL nested/dollar/atomic routines, MySQL DELIMITER, quoted/comment delimiters, malformed lexemes and rejected client commands.
assertions: Only server statements are sent in order.
unsupported client commands and unterminated lexemes block execution with source diagnostics.

scenarios.capability: Whole-batch review, exact ordered grants, safe dialog default and context invalidation

procedure.action: Review a mixed script containing allowed/write/destructive/unknown operations. Approve once, then edit SQL, Stop, switch profile or force an error before remaining work.
assertions: Review covers the exact ordered batch even if individual operations classify allowed.

scenarios.capability: Sequential first-error-stop scripts, skipped states, statement results plus ordered multi-set results

procedure.action: Execute success, first-error and middle-error scripts plus MySQL fixture_procedure multi-results. Switch tabs while results arrive.
assertions: Statements run sequentially until first error.

scenarios.capability: Original-source Unicode error navigation, execution fragment, active line number and success gutter clearing rules

procedure.action: Fail the second selected statement after non-BMP text and CRLF; navigate to error, correct it, rerun successfully, then edit the successful source.
assertions: Error and success gutter positions use original UTF-16 source.

scenarios.capability: UTF-8 SQL Open/Save/Save As, per-document file binding and safe file failure/cancel

procedure.action: Open UTF-8 files with non-BMP/combining paths and CRLF, edit/save/save-as in two documents; cancel chooser and test invalid UTF-8/locked destination.
assertions: Each tab retains its own file binding.
exact SQL and line endings survive.
cancellation/write failure leaves original binding/content/destination intact.

scenarios.capability: One-second draft autosave, flush, versioned snapshots, disconnected restore, no live state persisted

procedure.action: Edit a draft, wait one second, close/restart and force flush at shutdown; inspect snapshot and test corrupt/future versions.

scenarios.capability: Per-statement history, 1,000/30-day retention, enable/disable/clear/reopen and clear drafts

procedure.action: Execute a three-statement script and failed/cancelled variants; inspect history, reopen entry, exceed 1000 entries/30 days, disable, clear history and drafts, restart.
assertions: History is per statement with bounded retention.
reopening restores source without connecting or execution.

scenarios.capability: Schemas, tables/views/functions/procedures/triggers and metadata detail groups with lazy retry/refresh

procedure.action: Connect both fixtures; lazily expand schemas/table/view/function/procedure/trigger and detail groups; inject failure, retry and Refresh.
assertions: Every supported object/detail kind appears once.
refresh replaces removed metadata without cross-profile mixing.

scenarios.capability: Server catalog search across connected profiles independent of prior expansion

procedure.action: Search for an unexpanded synthetic object across two connected profiles; clear/change search during asynchronous replies.
assertions: Search goes to the server independently of prior expansion.
stale/profile-mismatched replies cannot replace current matches.

scenarios.capability: Structure/Definition/Open Data/Generate SELECT/adapter-quoted Copy Name and context actions

procedure.action: Invoke Structure, Definition, Open Data, Generate SELECT and Copy Name on table/view/routine with spaces/non-BMP names, using mouse and context-menu keyboard.
assertions: generated SQL opens without implicit execution.

scenarios.capability: Dedicated table docs, 200-row pages, PK tie-breaks, server sorting and nine typed filter operators

procedure.action: Open the fixture table with over 1000 rows, page at 200 rows, sort tied values, then apply all nine typed filter operators including NULL and clear filters.

scenarios.capability: Ordered duplicate columns, exact values/metadata, bounded display, truncation and partial/multiple sets

procedure.action: Run duplicate-name/NULL/empty/literal NULL/exact numeric/binary query and routine multi-sets; exceed 1000 rows and 8 MiB; fail a later set.
assertions: prior sets and partial error remain available.

scenarios.capability: Cell/range/sparse-row selection, context copy, TSV and typed clipboard JSON

procedure.action: Select a cell, rectangle and sparse whole rows. Copy from keyboard/context menu; inspect TSV plus typed clipboard JSON, including duplicate names and all special values.
assertions: Only intended cells/rows copy in source order.
JSON retains ordinals and typed NULL/binary.

scenarios.capability: Retained widths/selection, row numbering, horizontal overflow, virtualization and focus

procedure.action: Load the 1000x32 grid, resize columns, select rows, scroll vertically/horizontally, switch away/back and change theme/DPI; inspect focus and row numbers.

scenarios.capability: Row inspector, multiline/large/binary presentation and editable/read-only reasons

procedure.action: Open row inspector for NULL, empty, literal NULL, multiline, 1 MiB text and binary; toggle inspector and inspect editable/read-only reasons.
assertions: Large/binary data is bounded and accurate.
edit affordances and explanations follow adapter metadata.

scenarios.capability: Typed cell edits respecting adapter/type/PK/engine/privilege limits and NULL/DEFAULT semantics

procedure.action: Edit fixture nullable/default/text/numeric/binary cells; try generated, no-PK, view, restricted-privilege and MyISAM data.
assertions: unsupported cells explain why and cannot silently change values.

scenarios.capability: Local insert/update/delete drafts, original snapshots, markers, counts, Columns and Discard

procedure.action: Stage insert/update/delete, inspect original values/markers/counts/Columns, edit a value back to original, delete an inserted row, then Discard.
assertions: exact original snapshots and counts stay coherent.
reverting/discard restores content and selection safely.

scenarios.capability: Helper-generated parameterized SQL preview of an immutable batch and exact review

procedure.action: Stage a mixed immutable batch; Preview and review helper-generated parameterized SQL; mutate draft/context while preview reply is delayed.
assertions: Preview uses exact captured typed batch.
stale preview cannot authorize changed work.

scenarios.capability: Fresh idle Apply session, locked snapshots and stale context revalidation

procedure.action: Keep a SQL tab transaction open; Preview/Apply in grid, attempt edits/navigation/profile mutation while snapshot locked, then deliver stale reply.
assertions: Apply owns a fresh idle session.
locked snapshot/context is revalidated and stale completion rejected.

scenarios.capability: Atomic Apply, full original-row conflicts, metadata/constraint/deadlock rollback, Stop and reload

procedure.action: Apply a multi-row batch; use an observer to modify original rows or constraints/metadata; test deadlock and Stop during Apply.
assertions: All writes commit atomically or roll back.

scenarios.capability: Unknown COMMIT outcome blocks retry/reapply; explicit verification/discard/reload and close handling

procedure.action: Inject lost COMMIT ACK for SQL and Apply. Try retry/reapply, close, explicit verification via independent observer, then discard/reload.
assertions: Outcome stays unknown until explicitly resolved.
close preserves the uncertainty and recovery path.

scenarios.capability: Export Loaded uses captured snapshot, discloses truncation and executes no SQL

procedure.action: Capture a truncated loaded result, start Export Loaded, then switch tabs/replace results; inspect helper request count.
assertions: Export uses captured rows/metadata and discloses truncation.

scenarios.capability: Exact JSON metadata/value arrays and CSV NULL collision/quoting/binary/duplicate-column fidelity

procedure.action: Export shared grid to JSON and CSV with default NULL marker, then choose collision-free marker; inspect Unicode/CRLF/binary/numeric/duplicate-column content.
assertions: JSON uses ordered metadata/value arrays and exact strings.
CSV rejects marker collisions and quotes correctly.

scenarios.capability: Run to File executes once, exports all rows, JSON multi-set/CSV rejection, atomic destination and cancellation

procedure.action: Run to File once on the over-limit query and multi-result routine; test JSON/CSV, Stop, first/middle errors and locked replacement.
assertions: Full rows export independently of display limit.
JSON supports multi-set and CSV rejects ambiguity.
failed/cancelled export never publishes partial output.

scenarios.capability: Separate offline helper LSP process, bounded framing, clean environment, versions/timeouts/fallback

procedure.action: Start offline completion with no DB; fragment/coalesce Content-Length frames, overflow/truncate, timeout/kill/restart the separate LSP process; inspect inherited environment.
assertions: LSP is separate from DB helper sessions, bounded and sanitized.

scenarios.capability: Automatic paginated completion metadata after explicit connect, Refresh, profile/session isolation

procedure.action: Explicitly connect each fixture, paginate completion metadata, Refresh after adding/removing an object, then switch profiles during delayed metadata replies.
assertions: Metadata loads only after explicit connect through service session.
stale entries/replies are replaced without leakage.

scenarios.capability: Clause/scope completion, CTE/subquery/LATERAL/aliases/projections, FK joins and match ranking/highlights

procedure.action: Run shared completion fixtures for CTE/subquery/correlated/LATERAL/alias/projection/ambiguous columns and FK JOIN/ON; inspect ranking and fuzzy UTF-16 highlights.
assertions: Scope-correct suggestions, quoting, ranking, abbreviation/typo matching and highlighted spans match the Go oracle for both dialects.

scenarios.capability: Automatic/manual popup, navigation/insertion/Escape, quoting, one Undo, IME and stale-reply safety

procedure.action: Type and manually invoke completion, navigate/accept with Tab and Return, dismiss Escape, Undo once; repeat in literal/comment and IME composition and with delayed stale replies.
assertions: Popup appears only in valid context.
insertion quotes safely and is one Undo.

scenarios.capability: Function signature help/active arguments/overloads/nested-named-default-variadic calls and diagnostics

procedure.action: Run all shared signature cases including nested/SUBSTRING/named/default/variadic/overload/Unicode; type/change caret/Escape/Undo, refresh connected routine metadata and switch theme/DPI.
assertions: Correct function/overload/active UTF-16 parameter and return type display.
offline built-ins need no DB queries.

scenarios.capability: Shared command registry, exact context capture, desktop menus and focus/modal gating

procedure.action: Invoke Run/Script/Stop/Run to File from toolbar/menu/keyboard while editor, grid, chooser and modal dialog have focus; switch document before delayed completion.
assertions: One command registry captures exact context.
focus/modal/busy gating is identical across entry points.

scenarios.capability: Shortcut recording/rebinding/unbinding/reset/conflict checks and preference recovery

procedure.action: Record/rebind/unbind/reset execution shortcuts, provoke duplicate/protected-key conflicts, restart, and load corrupt preferences; repeat under non-Latin layout/AltGr.
assertions: menus/toolbar/keyboard stay synchronized using native keys.

scenarios.capability: Persistent System/Lager/Porter, independent app/editor schemes, Follow App Appearance and previews

procedure.action: Select System/Lager/Porter and named app scheme; select independent editor scheme/Follow App Appearance, preview and restart.
assertions: Preferences persist independently with safe fallback.
system changes update only following choices.

scenarios.capability: Bundled theme library and JSON/JSONC/TextMate/JetBrains imports, safe includes, durable storage/notices

procedure.action: Load bundled schemes and all shared imports including JSONC include/TextMate/JetBrains; delete source and reload; remove custom; test traversal/symlink/cycle/remote/XML entity/size attacks.
assertions: unsafe input is rejected and corrupt library preserved.

scenarios.capability: Live theme updates preserve editing/execution/selection and readable full app surfaces

procedure.action: During active editor Undo/selection/scroll, result selection and query execution, switch app/editor light/dark/system choices and render every dialog/popup/settings screen.
assertions: Live themes keep editing/execution state and readable text/icons/hover/focus/selection.
native light controls have correct contrast.

scenarios.capability: Native file/CA dialogs, desktop keyboard/clipboard/IME, Unicode/CRLF paths, DPI/fonts/window conventions

procedure.action: Use native Open/Save/CA choosers and clipboard on Unicode/CRLF paths; type via IME/non-Latin/AltGr, move focus by keyboard, change fractional/mixed DPI and window bounds.
assertions: Desktop conventions and exact text survive.

scenarios.capability: Real Credential Manager/Secret Service access, locked/missing/empty behavior and standard-user security

procedure.action: As standard user, create/read/update/delete a unique fixture credential in real native store; test missing/empty/locked/unavailable service and rollback failure.
assertions: Credential Manager/Secret Service roundtrip succeeds privately.
no plaintext fallback, unrelated credential access or loss of existing password.

scenarios.capability: UIA/Narrator and AT-SPI/Orca roles/values/focus for full editor/grid/dialog workflows

procedure.action: With Narrator/UIA or Orca/AT-SPI, navigate editor, virtualized grid, NULL/binary cells, inspector, menus, Settings and dialogs entirely by keyboard.
assertions: modal safe defaults and row/column position are operable.
rendering/headless tests do not substitute for this run.

scenarios.capability: Helper lifecycle, matching executable, no Windows console, cancellation/backpressure/death recovery

procedure.action: Launch exact packaged helper, check protocol/version and no Windows console; saturate stream, Stop, kill only owned helper and retry/recover.
assertions: helper death surfaces correct disconnected/unknown state.

scenarios.capability: Stable product ID/icons/version metadata, prototype migration and separate Mac SwiftUI product

procedure.action: Inspect candidate GUI/helper version/build/icons/identity; migrate a copied prototype library and credentials; launch old/new simultaneously; independently rebuild Mac SwiftUI.
assertions: Stable identity retains IDs/credentials without data races.

scenarios.capability: Supported runtime/GPU dependencies, packages/checksums/notices/signing policy and manual update

procedure.action: On clean standard-user desktops, verify archive/package checksum/notices/dependencies and signing/provenance policy, extract/install, launch without Go/Rust, then manually update.
assertions: Documented Windows runtime/Linux glibc/GPU/Secret Service requirements suffice.

scenarios.capability: Clean install/update/remove, repeated-launch ownership and preserved profiles/UUIDs/credentials/drafts/history/settings

procedure.action: Install exact previous/candidate artifacts in an owned fixture; exercise repeated launch, preserve profiles/UUIDs/credentials/drafts/history/settings, restart/update/remove.
assertions: removal does not touch unrelated user data or processes.

scenarios.capability: Both engine families/versions, real TLS, faults, native desktop and upgrade completed-run evidence

procedure.action: Run every required scenario on Windows 11 x64 and Ubuntu 24.04 x64 Wayland/X11 with PostgreSQL 16/17/18 and MySQL 8.0/8.4, TLS/fault/upgrade cases; audit summaries and skips.
assertions: Every native column has exact artifact/build/session/engine evidence and completed-run summary.

policy: Prepared procedures never count as executed native evidence; each engine and assertion must complete.
